user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Strategic system builder ensuring usability and data privacy.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes. Zero candidate applications/ folders were touched. Audited default_user and profile_context.py discovery logic.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. Designed complete demo schemas and verified ProfileContext auto-discovery ignores default_user.
evolutionary_takeaways: Candidate data privacy is sacred. Output directories are runtime-generated and should not be touched during onboarding.
